name: Consecrate
components: M (holy water and silver dust worth 25 gp)
summary: Bless an area to strengthen positive channel energy and disrupt undead.
description: Positive channel energy gains a +3 sacred bonus to its save DC in the area. Undead there take a –1 penalty on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves, and cannot be created or summoned there. A permanent shrine to your religion doubles these modifiers. If the area has a permanent shrine to another patron, the spell instead severs the shrine’s connection to its patron and applies neither modifier. Consecrate counters and dispels desecrate.
